name: Blueprint
description: Creates the instance's children from a map of steps: one instance of the child schema per step, linked to the instance and blocked by the children of the steps it comes after, all in one transaction that a failure refuses whole. The steps are inline in the config, stamped when the instance is created, or held by a definition the instance links to, pinned to a revision, stamped when that link is first set. A step can depend on the instance's fields (when); a step left out passes its dependencies on to the steps that come after it.

copyFields.description: Fields of this type copied to every child, a field of the child's type of the same name.

copyLinks.description: Links of this type copied to every child, a link of the child's Links config of the same name to the same schema, keeping the revision a pinned one records. Only with from: an instance holds no link when it is created.

from.description: Where the steps are kept as an instance: a pinned link of this type's Links config, and the field of the linked instance that holds a map of steps of the same form as steps. The steps are read from the revision the link pins and stamped when the link is first set.

field.description: The field of the linked instance's type that holds the steps.

link.description: A pinned link of this type's Links config.

keyField.description: A string field of the child schema's type that each child gets its step's key in.

parentLink.description: The link of the child schema's Links config that points at this schema; each child is linked to its parent through it.

schema.description: The child schema. It composes Links with parentLink, Dependencies when a step comes after another, and not Blueprint.

after.description: The keys of the steps whose children block this step's child.

data.description: Fields of the child, beside its key and the copied fields.

when.description: Stamps the step only when the instance's field equals a value, or is a list that includes one; absent, always.

equals.description: The value the field must equal, as JSON.

field.description: A field of this schema's type.

includes.description: A value the field, a list, must include, as JSON.

steps.description: The steps, by key, stamped when the instance is created.

fields.name: blueprint
fields.description: What was stamped: children, each step's key and its child's id, in the order they were created; absent until the instance is stamped.
